skills.name: ai-integration-architect
skills.description: Design, plan, and scaffold AI integration into enterprise systems. Use this skill whenever the user wants to connect AI (LLMs, agents, RAG, embeddings) to their existing tech stack — whether that means generating MCP servers, designing integration architecture, building API connectors, setting up data pipelines for RAG, or planning how AI agents interact with databases, CRMs, ERPs, or internal tools. Also trigger when the user mentions "integrate AI", "connect Claude to", "MCP server for", "AI architecture", "agentic workflow", "embed AI into", "AI middleware", "enterprise AI", "RAG pipeline", "system integration with AI", "AI-ready infrastructure", or discusses connecting any external system to an AI agent. If someone is trying to bring AI into their organization's existing systems, this is the skill to use.
